candidates.implementation: Model Picker host with A5b/evidence variants: T:mp/a5b, T:mp/a5b+ad, T:mp/a5b+ad+rb; earlier devC T:mp/a5b1, T:mp/qsg1, T:mp/H2, T:mp/H4.
candidates.coverage_reconciliation: The requirement 'Model Picker + improved mechanism (vs MP, D1, D6)' is covered in the final devA comparison: T:mp/a5b is compared with the model_picker_adapter (MP host), D1, and D6:mp. `contrasts.json` contains the D1 and D6:mp contrasts; the MP-host contrast is in `dev_summary.md` and the underlying devA records, not in `contrasts.json`. Dev summary gives mean alternative J 397.7 for T:mp/a5b, versus 354.4 for model_picker_adapter, 369.5 for D1, and 377.2 for D6:mp, so it is worse by about +43.4, +28.2, and +20.5 respectively. The additional A5b acquisition adaptation was essentially neutral versus T:mp/a5b (+0.1 [-1.7,+1.9] for +ad). devC adds comparison to same host under QSG/H2/H4 alternatives but is an earlier version and should not be pooled as the final T1 setting. Thus comparison coverage is satisfied; benefit criterion is not.
candidates.disposition: Stop current T1 configuration; preserve direct negative result. No claim of published-method superiority.

candidates.implementation: Gated Deployment host with A5b, env8 and QSG evidence; front-loaded acquisition and AND-combination ablations.
candidates.finding: T2:gated/a5b has zero promotions on the four declared dev null screens and alternative mean J 395.7; the historical +23.6 contrast versus `choe_ramdas_eb+front` is exploratory against a non-author-native port and is not published-SOTA evidence; the within-class contrast versus gated_adaptive_range is -4.7 (CI [-11.3,1.9]). The env8 variant has 0.30 promotion on rho=.95 null, outside its declared rho<=.8 class. Front-loading improves the synthetic alternative cost for some contrasts; the separate gated_adaptive_range+front and gated_deployment+QCE+front comparators reach 0.35 promotion on the harder rho=.95 Markov-null screen, while T2:gated/a5b+front has 0/20 there. Fresh real results vary substantially by stream. The 'best cert' arithmetic in old summaries is an exploratory comparator selection; it is not a published-SOTA claim.
candidates.disposition: No general advance; retain as host/evidence compatibility and misspecification study.

candidates.implementation: CAMS host with A5b, conditional-mean and Markov evidence modules (including host-only/adaptive-query variants).
candidates.finding: At dev alpha .05, CAMS adapter mean alternative J 350.5, but it has high false promotions (1.00 F0_null, .50 F0_worse, .95 rho=.8, .95 rho=.95). Conditional-mean variants are more conservative (T:cams/cmean J 385.5; cmean_s 383.7); env8 has 0.15 rho=.95 promotion but a declared rho<=.8 assumption. Twin promotion rates vary widely: T:cams/a5b .075-.092 on four twins and 0 on twin_metro; cmean .009-.442. These one-seed-per-twin rates are descriptive only.
candidates.disposition: Evidence mechanism materially changes risk/cost; CAMS raw performance is not a safe result due to null promotions.

candidates.finding: The frozen A5b setting transfers with zero promotions on F0/F0_worse/rho=.8/rho=.95 dev null screens, but is more costly than host adapters: T:mp/a5b 397.7 vs model_picker_adapter 354.4; T:ms/a5b 395.8 vs model_selector_causal 347.0. candidates.implementation: Evidence x acquisition 2x2: A5b or env8 with C2/C6 and front/base acquisition on gated host.
candidates.finding: For A5b x C2 the estimated interaction is +0.8 [-1.5,+3.0] in dev; acquisition effect at best evidence is -0.6 [-1.9,+0.7]. A5b x C6 interaction is also recorded in contrasts.json. T6:a5bxC2 has 0/20 promotions on the four dev null screens and alternative mean J 391.1; the comparison to the prior selected `choe_ramdas_eb+front` port is historical and exploratory; that non-author-native port cannot support published-SOTA inference. Track-R points are reported, e.g. at R20 risk .087 [.043,.170], cost 374.2 [368.7,379.8] at alpha .5. Fresh-real comparison to A5b is mixed; twin promotion ranges 0-.083 for T6, one policy seed per split.
candidates.disposition: No evidence of an interaction gain; retain the null interaction estimate and scoped cost-risk curves.

interpretation_limits: The exact T1 requirement is met in devA: Model Picker candidate is compared against its host adapter, D1 and D6:mp. DevC is an earlier variant/sensitivity screen, not interchangeable with devA.
Xu acquisition-only appears in shared comparator sets. It is not Xu et al.'s published certification method and must not support published-SOTA superiority claims.
Some older 'best certified' contrasts select and evaluate on overlapping development seeds. Recompute after comparator reclassification and account for selection before confirmatory statements.
Real fresh/twin runs have limited seeds and reused twins; these do not establish external validity or causal change response.
The Track-R report is only a summarized selected operating-point subset. Its starred Pareto marks are conditional on the tested candidates/grid and are exploratory.
